association.title: Espaço ao Cubo
association.subtitle: Student association dedicated to developing space technology and promoting education in aerospace engineering
association.intro1: We are a passionate group of students united by the dream of reaching space. Our team brings together engineering students from various fields, working collaboratively to develop the first Portuguese CubeSat entirely designed and built by students.
association.intro2: Beyond the technical challenge, we believe in the power of education and inspiration. We conduct workshops in schools, participate in events, and share our passion for space with the community, showing that the sky is not the limit.
